text:
- **Records and site views:** The site now shows each record's published version and every draft as a full version. Renaming a design page or doc now rewrites every link to it.
- **Owner questions and replies:** Ask-tool questions now take an answer from the site as well as from chat. The answer that arrives first closes the question.
- **AGENTS.md check and CI:** The AGENTS.md check now gives the same verdict on every rerun. CI runs its slow jobs daily, not on every pull request.
- **Repo setup and tooling:** This repo runs a newer pm release, and its service restarted on it. Claude Code auto memory is off here, and pm no longer installs a git hook.
